Subject: Interested in a demo — benchmark report download

Hi Marissa,

I downloaded the "Inference benchmark: cost & latency tradeoffs" report from your site earlier today — very helpful. We're evaluating options to replace our in-house serving layer (current infra: mixed GPUs across cloud regions) and want to understand Redwood's Dedicated and Private offering, plus how your batching/caching impacts unit costs for long-tail prompts.

Can we schedule a demo next week to walk through:
- How Redwood handles KV cache warmup for long sequences
- Typical latency/throughput for 4k+ context on A100/RTX (or similar)
- Options for private deployment / VPC connectivity

Our team: me (Data Platform lead) + Mike (Platform eng). We're available late mornings PST most days next week.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Senior Data Platform Engineer
Acme Analytics
